title: Identifying Gender Stereotypes and Biases in Automated Translation from English to Italian using Similarity Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the cosine similarity between gender-specific target words (e.g., she/he, lei/lui) and a dataset of various words using FastText embeddings. The paper introduces numerical features such as 'GenderBiasIntensity' and 'GenderBiasDirection' to quantify the magnitude and direction of the bias, and evaluates how these metrics shift after performing English-to-Italian translation using Google Translate.
